limitations: A single baseline-first 900-second public run does not establish hidden-score transfer or repeatability.
ft09 is the largest positive game, but its only captured explicit runs read prints initial ranges; indirect influence of that output cannot be isolated.
r11l computes from runs and advances one more level, but this is not a controlled causal attribution to exact footprints.
cd82 consumes runs yet regresses two levels; ar25 uses runs but makes an incorrect object-selection assumption.
The remaining nine-game mean after excluding ft09 is -1.7870, a descriptive concentration check rather than an alternative official score.
Recorded usage and analyzer token totals are different measurements and must not be added.
